title: keep it low
style: Dark pop with industrial and electronic influences. The track features a heavy, distorted synth bass and a processed drum kit with a sharp snare and a punchy kick. A female vocalist delivers breathy, whispered verses that transition into a powerful, belted chorus. Atmospheric synth pads and metallic percussion hits provide texture. The arrangement uses sudden dynamic shifts and rhythmic silence for impact. Tempo is 100 BPM in the key of G minor.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[heavy breathing]
[distorted synth bass enters]

[Verse 1]
[whispered female vocals]
Hmm
Step on the cord
All systems go
Ready to play the game
Let's keep it low, keep it low
What?
[kick drum and snare enter]
I can't hear you
Keep it low
Say what?
Your back, keep it low
Your butt, keep it low
Your knees, keep it low
Your pedal, keep it low
And take it slow, slow, slow

[Chorus]
[full electronic drums, belted vocals]
Get down, ready to play
Keep it low and let it flow
The game is yours to take, you know
Keep it low
What?
Keep it low
Say what?

[Verse 2]
[drums drop out, bass continues]
Your ball, keep it low
Your drop, keep it low
Your eyes, keep it low
And take it slow, slow, slow
